name: v2.5.21-dev.59-alpha1
body:
## What's new in v2.5.21-dev.59-alpha1

- fix(player): read LMS's real "mixer volume" status field for volume slider
- fix(update): make hifi-update-runner.sh executable, self-heal on devices missing it
- ci(pages): deploy via Actions instead of relying on the legacy Pages builder
- fix(build): fail ISO/OTA build instead of silently shipping without web-admin
- fix(player): bust now-playing cover cache on artist/album change too
- fix(webui): show the alpha OTA channel option when unlocked
- fix(player): fetch now-playing cover via LMS's own /music/current/cover.jpg
- fix(player): resolve remote artwork_url against the LMS origin, add fallback to expanded view
- fix(player): prevent volume slider snap-back during drags
- fix(player): request artwork_url tag so radio/streaming covers load
- fix(webui): proxy /api/system/ui_resolution from the web admin
- perf(kiosk): render the UI at a lower resolution on large panels
- fix(player): show real radio cover art; render artist bio as plain text
